transcript_text: Started the new semester week today. Feeling energetic, motivated, and ready to tackle OS and algorithms coursework!
Operating systems lab had a tricky segmentation fault. It took two hours to debug thread deadlocks, but managed to submit it.
Falling behind on recursion and dynamic programming homework problem sets. Deadlines are piling up and anxiety is creeping in.
Stayed awake until 4 AM stressing about upcoming midterm exams. Brain feels completely foggy and exhausted in lectures.
Bombed the surprise quiz in database systems today. Feeling completely lost, overwhelmed, and like I don't belong in this program.
Struggled to even get out of bed this morning. Skipped classes all day. Everything feels like too much weight on my chest.
Total mental burnout. I can't catch up anymore and I feel completely hopeless about this semester. I don't know what to do.
